title: Name with accents and apostrophe
why: Checks that non-ASCII letters, apostrophes and hyphens are stored without corruption.

steps.does: On UserCreated, register a passenger with Name "Zoë O'Brien-Müller", PassportNumber 'Z1122334', Female, Age 31.

expect: A Passenger is created and the name reads back exactly as "Zoë O'Brien-Müller".
